title: Shadow Fleet — same ship, changing names and managers
scope_note: Public-source sanctions and asset-resolution case. Stable IMO identifiers are used to link vessel records across changing names. Historical ownership/management records are not presented as current without time-bounded verification.

sources.title: UK sanctions package — Russian oil tankers
sources.exact_location: 17 Oct 2024 list including NS ARCTIC (IMO 9413547) and SCF BAIKAL (IMO 9422457)
supports: The UK named NS ARCTIC with IMO 9413547 and SCF BAIKAL with IMO 9422457 in its 17 October 2024 shadow-fleet sanctions package.
sources.does_not_prove: A 2024 vessel name is not a permanent identity field and does not establish the vessel's current name, owner or manager.

sources.title: UK Sanctions List — ship designations
sources.exact_location: RUS2231 NS ARCTIC, IMO 9413547; RUS2234 SCF BAIKAL, IMO 9422457
supports: The UK sanctions list ties the ship designations to stable IMO numbers rather than names alone.
RUS2231 identifies NS ARCTIC as IMO 9413547 and RUS2234 identifies SCF BAIKAL as IMO 9422457.
sources.does_not_prove: The sanctions list does not by itself establish current beneficial ownership or every subsequent change of vessel name and management.

sources.title: Council Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2588
sources.exact_location: Entities 684–685: Nova Shipmanagement LLC-FZ and Citrine Marine SPC; vessels include Amulet IMO 9413547 and Bobcat IMO 9422457
supports: The EU listed Nova Shipmanagement LLC-FZ and Citrine Marine SPC on 15 December 2025.
The legal act says Nova manages tankers including Amulet (IMO 9413547) and Bobcat (IMO 9422457), and describes Citrine as a UAE company owning tankers and associated with Nova.
The same IMO numbers connect the EU names Amulet/Bobcat to the UK names NS ARCTIC/SCF BAIKAL.
sources.does_not_prove: The act is a dated legal record. It should not be treated as proof that the same owner or manager remains current after later transfers or name changes, and it does not identify a natural-person ultimate beneficial owner for the vessels.

sources.title: EU Council — shadow-fleet enablers sanctions
sources.exact_location: 15 Dec 2025 announcement explaining four listed shipping entities in UAE, Vietnam and Russia
supports: The Council said the listed shipping companies own or manage tankers subject to restrictive measures and transporting Russian crude or petroleum products while using irregular and high-risk shipping practices.
sources.does_not_prove: The press release is a summary; exact entity and vessel relationships should be checked in the underlying legal act.

sources.title: Ukraine War & Sanctions — IMO 9413547
sources.publisher: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine (GUR) — War & Sanctions
sources.exact_location: Vessel IMO 9413547; current portal title ALTAIR; former name NS Arctic; owner/manager fields dated in the record
supports: The portal identifies the vessel by IMO 9413547 and records former name NS Arctic.

The displayed record lists Celestine Navigation Inc as ship owner dated 8 Nov 2024, Stream Ship Management FZCO as commercial manager dated 16 Mar 2024, and Sterling Ship Management LLC-FZ as safety manager dated 21 Feb 2025.
sources.does_not_prove: Those owner/manager fields carry their own dates and differ from the later EU legal act. They cannot be presented as the vessel's current ownership/management on 1 Sep 2026 without a fresh authoritative registry check.

sources.title: Ukraine War & Sanctions — IMO 9422457
sources.publisher: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine (GUR) — War & Sanctions
sources.exact_location: Vessel IMO 9422457; current portal title BLOSSOM; former names SCF Vankor / SCF BAIKAL; owner/manager fields dated 11 Nov 2024
supports: The portal identifies the vessel by IMO 9422457 and records former name SCF BAIKAL.
The displayed record lists Cuper Marine LTD c/o Avebury Shipmanagement LLC-FZ as owner and Avebury Shipmanagement LLC-FZ as commercial and safety manager, dated 11 Nov 2024.
sources.does_not_prove: These dated fields precede the December 2025 EU record referring to Bobcat and Nova/Citrine. The selected records therefore show a changing/contested temporal picture rather than a single timeless ownership fact.

sources.title: Ukraine War & Sanctions — ARROW, IMO 9413561
sources.publisher: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine (GUR) — War & Sanctions
sources.exact_location: ARROW, IMO 9413561; owner Citrine Marine SPC dated 7 May 2025; Nova Shipmanagement commercial manager dated 24 Aug 2025
supports: The GUR record independently links ARROW IMO 9413561 to Citrine Marine SPC as ship owner and Nova Shipmanagement LLC-FZ as commercial manager on dated records in 2025.
This relationship is consistent with the companies later named in the EU legal act.
sources.does_not_prove: One corroborated vessel relationship does not establish identical ownership and management for every vessel in the wider network or a natural-person beneficial owner behind Citrine/Nova.
